notes.title: Development Progress
notes.notes: [p]Since the successful conclusion of the Kickstarter we have been hard at work bringing Galaxy Princess Zorana towards launch state. The testing process for players with beta-keys is ongoing. The game is playable end-to-end except for the lack of the final epilogue, credits, and things that would normally be unlocked by completion (gallery, deaths list, achievements, etc). The in-game codex has also not been filled out at this point. Partly we're keeping an eye on player questions to see what else might need to be added.[/p][p]Based on player input, bugs are being ironed out, additional text is being added, and UI is being tweaked. A few beta-tester streams exist, if you're curious (of course, these rapidly become outdated as new patches drop)[/p][p]The first backer-designed character was added to the game in the last patch:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45423147/576dd25f8514b30f87a99911badd61718d9119bc.png"][/img][/p][p]We do not have a specific launch date planned at this point. Yes, it's still very likely it will be out before the end of the year. It's also possible it will roll over into 2026 if we decide to wait until more content is added.[/p][p]From the stretch goals list, the additional Romance Graphics and Aliens will definitely not be available this year (the art will take too long to complete) and will probably be added post-launch. The Rebel ending is more possible but unknown at this point.[/p][p]The key point is - things are happening! We are very much in motion![/p]

notes.title: Trailer live, now funding on Kickstarter
notes.notes:
We know we've kept you waiting for news but now we have some exciting things to announce!

First off, if you check the Steam page, you should see that we have a brand-new trailer available which should provide an overview for the game and a few smiles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45423147/f3cfd909bcac5bb8130db5342a5ac9012bd91cba.png[/img]

Secondly, the game is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hanako/galaxy-princess-zorana-long-live-the-queen-in-space?ref=4pz2oc]now funding on Kickstarter[/url]. We will not be doing Early Access on Steam so if you want to get in on the beta level and make suggestions while the game is in development (or snag one of the special offers) this is the time to do it. But if not, don't fear, the game will get here eventually!

It's been a long road getting here and we're very excited (AND STRESSED!) and looking forward to being able to invite players into our world soon!
